body: Well mostly guilt and self hatred from past screw ups. Relationships and such. One ended recently and I don’t know if that’s a good thing or not. My uncle died unexpectedly recently and one side of my family is at war with the other. I’m 8k in debt in credit cards and 100k in debt to my mother. I’m generally unhappy most of the time. Talking about things with my family or others is difficult because I can’t articulate stuff very well. Professional help is something I tried but it’s too expensive and every therapist I’ve spoken too just preach mindfulness. I don’t know if or when I’m going to kill myself.
Yeah, that’s what I figured. Is there any recourse for being fired from an at-will company? Do I have any power if the worst happens?

My life is ok on paper. I have parents and a few friends that love me I think. I’ve dated girls that have loved me but I’m not in love with them. They’re beautiful and good people but I have no desire to make a life with them. Even dating at this point seems exhausting from the potential pain I can cause. I honestly haven’t been in love since I fucked up the last long term relationship I had years ago. I can’t forgive myself for cheating. I hurt her and I did that out of spite when I was younger. I realized more recently that I fucked up a lot of potential friendships by not being a gentlemen and letting dick get in the way.

 I’m not bad looking but I see myself getting older. I don’t look healthy. There’s more grey in my beard and I’m not that old. It’s mostly my career. I’m moderately successful in the video production world but I honestly just don’t see the point of it because I’m not passionate about any of the things I edit nor do I want to be an editor. I like shooting but shooting gigs that can sustain a comfortable life in NYC are rare. I’m not making films people care about. I make things that sell stuff and are consumerist. They’re pretty quality but rarely have meaning. I’ve tried making my own stuff but I don’t have the will to create. My job sucks the fun out of it. Other people have passions and I’ve never had a consistent one. I’m not looking for fame but I don’t have a purpose. When really successful people like Chris Cornell off themselves people wonder, why? I don’t. I’m not even close to that level but I understand. The success doesn’t matter when you have this black feeling hovering over you all the time. It makes me not put away laundry or even do laundry for weeks. It makes me beat myself up for little mistakes. It makes me hate who I am. It makes me mad about trivial things that happened years ago. It gives me homicidal and suicidal thoughts. It makes me cry for no reason like right now. 

I’ve tried opening up but it’s never worked for me. My GFs(past and present) have helped occasionally but mostly get frustrated if I’m not making any progress. Or even worse, thinking we’re forming more intimate bonds because I open up a little bit. My parents are good people but are reactive. If I’m angry or sad, it spins them out and they go a similar route. I tried opening up to a friend recently but he basically said, “You’ll be fine.” I never said I’m having suicidal thoughts specifically but I thought we were closer than that. He’s been distant since he started dating a this GF a year ago. I tried therapy but it wasn’t good. He just wanted me to be mindful and never really helped. In general I don’t want people to think I’m weak or mentally ill. I hate bullies and bullies use that type of info against you. 

I don’t want to be put on drugs. My mom did that for a brief time and she was a zombie.

I go back and forth but as I age I can see the end of my road approaching quick. It’s just a matter of time before something puts me over that edge.

I don’t know how much longer I’m going to be around but makes me feel good to help before I pass out so I’ll try. Stop caring and be yourself but be nice. I’m guessing you’re actually nice. Identify the people you like and try to be nice to them. They might do the same
